title.narrative: Unlocking follow-up finance: Partnership Orange Corners (ESP) with Agence Emploi Jeunes

description.narrative: This project in Côte d’Ivoire supports youth-led enterprises that have previously participated in the Orange Corners and te Orange Corners Innovation Fund (OCIF) programme by helping them access follow-up financing from Agence Emploi Jeunes (AEJ). Many of these enterprises face challenges in securing loans due to limited capacity to prepare investment dossiers and manage funds effectively. By providing tailored technical assistance (TA) and monitoring support, this project ensures that these enterprises can responsibly deploy AEJ loans, absorb financing, and achieve sustainable growth. The initiative is led by Entrepreneurial Solutions Partners (ESP), this projects' Orange Corners implementing partner in Côte d’Ivoire, who identify high-potential businesses, prepare them for bank financing, and provide ongoing support after loans are disbursed.The project aims to mobilise approximately EUR 400,000 in local financing. This partnership reduces credit risk for AEJ, while demonstrating a scalable model for supporting youth entrepreneurship in Côte d’Ivoire. Pilot results will capture lessons learned, impact metrics, and also communicate impact achieved through online profiles to inform the potential scaling of this project. By combining financial support with targeted enterprise development services, this project strengthens Côte d’Ivoire’s startup ecosystem, promotes youth entrepreneurship, and contributes to sustainable job creation.
